verdict.line: You lose isolated trades into Kled's Q-into-W burst before level 6, but you win the matchup overall (61% over 82 games) once Skaarl dismounts and your tank build outscales his damage.

brief.thesis: Kled's entire kit is built around a second health bar: Skaarl absorbs damage and powers his trades until it empties, at which point his damage to champions drops and his Q becomes a weak self-knockback. K'Sante doesn't need to win early poke — he needs to survive it, stack tank items, and punish the exact moment Skaarl dies. That's why the lane-advantage data favors Kled early while the head-to-head win rate (61%) favors K'Sante overall.

theirWindow.when: Skaarl's HP is high and Q is up
theirWindow.what: He can land Q (Bear Trap on a Rope, 800 range, 11-7s cooldown) to yank you in for bonus damage, then chain W (Violent Tendencies) for four empowered autos. Don't give him a straight-line hook and play around his Q cooldown rather than contesting every CS.

yourWindow.when: Skaarl's bar is near empty or he's dismounted
yourWindow.what: Dismounted Kled deals less damage to champions and his Q is replaced by Pocket Pistol, a ranged self-knockback with no hook. All-in immediately with E (Footwork) to close distance and R (All Out) to knock him through terrain — this is the trade you're built to win.

start.why: Flat health plus the potion buys the HP buffer you need to eat Q hooks and auto trades while you wait out his cooldowns; it's the 87.6%-picked start for a reason.

boots.why: Kled's damage is almost entirely basic attacks — his empowered W autos and Q-into-auto trades — so flat physical reduction on autos is the correct boot over Mercury's Treads here.

core.why: The Q proc slow punishes his E (Jousting) dash-back pattern and extends your window to land follow-up stuns after W (Path Maker).
Stacking resistances directly counters his flat AD trading pattern and scales every fight you survive into.
Omnivamp and extra health let you win extended trades once he's out of cooldowns, matching the measured Iceborn-into-Unending-Despair path.

situational.when: he rushes crit or attack speed and his W (Violent Tendencies) trades start winning fights outright
his auto-attack speed in extended trades is the main source of his damage
lane goes long and you need more sustain to out-heal his poke
their team shifts to magic damage after laning phase

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp sustain directly answers Kled's early poke pattern — every proc heals you back against his Q hook and auto trades while building the bonus health that blunts his burst.

summoners.why: Teleport (58.9% win rate, 80.2% pick) lets you reset the wave instead of forcing early trades you're mechanically disadvantaged in, buying time to reach the itemization window where you win. Flash+Ignite is the alternative if you want to punish his all-ins directly instead of scaling.

playing.title: Track Skaarl's HP bar
playing.detail: Watch the mount health bar under Kled's portrait all lane. Once it's critically low he's about to dismount, where he deals less damage to champions — that's your signal to commit.

playing.title: Respect Q range before 6
playing.detail: Bear Trap on a Rope has 800 range and an 11-7s cooldown. Don't stand in a straight line to him when it's up; make him walk up and miss it before you trade.

playing.title: Stack Q before committing
playing.detail: Your Q (3.5s cooldown) builds a stack per hit; at 2 stacks it fires a pulling shockwave. Land two hits first so the pull — not a raw trade — starts the fight on your terms.

playing.title: Hold E through his W window
playing.detail: Footwork's shield absorbs the burst from his four empowered W autos. Save it specifically for when his attack speed is visibly spiked, not as a poke-dodge tool.

playing.title: Save R for the dismount
playing.detail: All Out knocks him through walls and then transforms your kit with more damage and healing. Landing it right as Skaarl dies guarantees the kill instead of just resetting the fight.

playing.title: Don't contest early all-ins
playing.detail: Levels 3-5 he has E dash plus W attack speed online before your R exists. Trade passively and let Doran's Helm sustain you rather than matching his aggression.

playing.title: Scale through Iceborn into Jak'Sho
playing.detail: Your tank itemization outpaces his flat AD scaling by mid-game. Play for farm and short trades from 10+ rather than forcing fights — the matchup wins itself if you reach full build.

brief.patchCaveat: The build paths, boots, runes, summoner spells, and win rates above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch; the trade timing, power spikes, and mechanical reads are our own tactical analysis layered on top of that data.
